paragraphs: Week 4 (Sept 25 – 29, Lectures 7 and 8) Teaching and Learning
3.9 Linearization and differential: linearization and standard linear approximation; differentials; error in linear approximation (or differential approximation); proof of the chain rule.

4.1 Extreme values of functions: absolute (or global) extrema and Theorem 1; local extrema and Theorem 2; critical points; finding the global extrema for a continuous function defined on a closed and bounded interval.
4.2 The mean value theorem: Rolle’s theorem; the mean value theorem and its consequences (Corollaries 1 and 2).
4.3 Monotonic functions and the first derivative test: monotonicity; first derivative test.
